Bottom line: The administration is moving to restructure federal science funding away from major universities and is defending keyword-based grant terminations, while also rolling back civil-rights compliance rules—each with direct financial and legal exposure for us.

🔴 **Keyword Grant Cuts** - Agencies admitted screening on diversity, gender, and COVID terms to terminate ~$2B in UC grants now challenged as unconstitutional, signaling both litigation leverage and continued risk to our awards.

🔴 **Kratsios Science Report** - White House calls for cutting funding to leading universities, replacing investigator-led grants with large team "grand challenge" awards, and moving beyond peer review—threatening our core research model.

🟠 **Funding Outside Academia** - New strategy steers agencies to fund individual "blue-sky" researchers who choose host institutions and favors multiyear grants, pressuring our indirect-cost base and early-career pipeline.

🟠 **HHS Title VI Rollback** - HHS rescinded disparate-impact provisions, changing compliance obligations for federally funded programs.
